title: Your Belly Fat Is an Emergency: 7 Reasons to Take It Seriously
hook: Belly fat affects far more than the mirror.
body: It can change how you feel, how you move and how seriously you take your health. In this video I break down seven reasons I stopped treating it casually, then the five moves I used to force the spiral in the other direction.
close: If you're ready to stop treating it casually, start with one measurable action today.
